40017.notes: Oklahoma tax resale (deed) market via County Treasurer. Canadian County Treasurer collects ad valorem taxes and manages county-owned property acquired at the annual sale of real estate for delinquent taxes; may resell with Board of County Commissioners approval (314 W Rogers, El Reno). Statewide pattern: annual June resale of long-delinquent parcels with deed at sale; redemption must occur before resale commencement (Title 68 §3113, effective changes noted 2025). Separate Sheriff foreclosure sales (mortgage/judgment) Mondays ~10 a.m. — not the tax resale. Confirm current June resale list and registration with Treasurer 405-295-6330.

41043.notes: Oregon tax-foreclosure → county tax-title system (ORS 312 / ORS 275). Linn County does not sell tax lien certificates. After foreclosure and redemption period expires, fee title vests in the county; Property Management sells tax-foreclosed inventory via public auction (no set annual month) or private sealed bid. If real market value > $15,000 and parcel is buildable, public auction required; otherwise sealed bid allowed. Industrial parcels may skip auction. Last documented public sale May 22, 2024, 10 a.m., Linn County Courthouse, Albany. Notice ~4 weeks in Albany Democrat-Herald + website + email list. Sold AS IS; no remaining former-owner redemption after conveyance.

53057.notes: Washington tax-deed county (RCW 84.64). Skagit County Treasurer begins foreclosure when taxes are three years delinquent; Certificate of Delinquency filed in Superior Court; costs accrue (can exceed $500/parcel). Redemption allowed until close of business day before sale — none on sale day. Annual public auction historically fall (minimum bid sheets usually available early November). Unsold parcels become tax title held in trust; may also sell surplus fee-title via application ($50 deposit) and Commissioner approval (~8 months). Bid4Assets has hosted some online foreclosure/re-offer cycles. Sold AS IS/WHERE IS; Treasurer’s deed does not warrant clear title.
53057.auctionFormat: In-person (primary foreclosure auction); occasional online re-offers / tax-title process

auctionPlatform.label: Skagit County Treasurer — Tax Foreclosure / Tax Title / Surplus Sales

53057.auctionFrequency: Annual foreclosure auction (typically fall; min-bid lists ~Nov 1); tax-title/surplus sales as applications approved
53057.depositRules: Bidders or representatives must register morning of auction and pay by cash, cashier’s check, or postal money order within ~2 hours of sale close (no personal/business checks). Failure to pay → rebid excluding original bidder. Tax-title applications: $50 deposit with Application to Purchase County Property. Research dikes, flood, and shoreline rules before bidding.
